matchingRules.description: Two contact records are the same person when they share an email address, or when they share a last name and a mailing postal code. These are the keys the Open Impact import framework already uses to decide that an incoming row is somebody the org has, so an import and a duplicate scan agree about what the same person means (canonical model R-DP2). Both comparisons are exact and neither matches on a blank value.
matchingRules.label: Open Impact contact match
